name: lumen-cinema
description: Cinema seat reservation system with server-enforced selection rules

scripts.build: npm run build -w @lumen/shared && npm run build -w @lumen/api && npm run build -w @lumen/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @lumen/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @lumen/api" "npm run dev -w @lumen/web"
scripts.test: npm run build -w @lumen/shared && npm run test -w @lumen/shared && npm run test -w @lumen/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @lumen/shared && tsc -b apps/api apps/web --pretty
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test
